claims.sentence: Huntsman spiders belong to the Sparassidae family
Adults typically measure 15 to 30 millimetres across the body
They have venom to subdue prey but rarely bite humans
Even if bitten, the venom is not medically significant
Huntsman spiders do not cause systemic envenomation and pose no fatal risk
Redback spiders and funnel-web spiders are the only Australian spiders with venom of genuine medical concern
Do not use fipronil, bifenthrin, or any APVMA-registered spider product without reading the label first
This is illegal under the Health (Pesticides) Regulations 2011 in Western Australia
Work is carried out by, or under the direct supervision of, a technician holding a WA pest management technician's licence
Spider management typically costs between $220 and $300 for a standard three-bedroom home
General pest control that includes spiders costs between $250 and $350
Most spider management falls under our general re-treatment promise: 6 months
